governance_decisions.blocking_reason: Changing the duration impacts the master, build plan, Build-12, Build-13, merge gates, tests, and promotion semantics.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: Keep the canon at 7 days and treat 15 days as a change request, not as an automatic markdown correction.

targeted_audits.scope: Build-11 / Build-12 / Build-13 Shadow gate semantics
targeted_audits.conclusion: The official rule is not '30 days only'. It is 30 consecutive shadow days plus a complete/exploitable shadow report and post-shadow component verdicts before promotion.
targeted_audits.code_mapping: shadow_report_ready is the runtime representation of the canonical 'rapport shadow exploitable/complet' requirement.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Regression tests expecting 30-days-only behavior must be updated.

known_critical_gaps.scope: Build-11 doctrine vs actual closure criteria
known_critical_gaps.doc_expectation: Shadow 30 days as full system truth phase with A/B/C/D and Build-14 SHADOW_ENABLED, then post-Shadow verdict.
known_critical_gaps.code_or_runtime_reality: Autonomous Shadow VPS service and live_websocket support exist, but final operational proof and full doctrinal closure are not yet established.

known_critical_gaps.doc_expectation: C and D are SHADOW_ENABLED during the complete Shadow truth phase.
known_critical_gaps.code_or_runtime_reality: engine_c and engine_d package entrypoints still raise ImportError and some module inventory statuses remain planned.

known_critical_gaps.doc_expectation: Build-14 is SHADOW_ENABLED in Shadow, fully active there, then SHADOW_VALIDATED or DORMANT by verdict.
known_critical_gaps.code_or_runtime_reality: Some contracts and UI/monitoring payloads still default to read_only or limited_influence language.

known_critical_gaps.doc_expectation: Hard States must be explicit and coherent across protocols, monitoring, UI, and promotion gates.
known_critical_gaps.code_or_runtime_reality: Partial exposure exists, but the whole stack is not yet clearly normalized around one final vocabulary.

known_critical_gaps.doc_expectation: Runtime-relevant features need real proof before final requalification.
known_critical_gaps.code_or_runtime_reality: The feature is coded and tested, but exchange-network proof is still pending in this environment.

known_critical_gaps.doc_expectation: Build-11 / Build-13 gate semantics must be consistent across canonical docs, runtime gates, and regression tests.
known_critical_gaps.code_or_runtime_reality: Current runtime gate effectively requires 30 consecutive days plus shadow_report_ready, while part of the regression suite still expects the older 30-days-only behavior.
